summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. reporting the results of its 2026 Annual and Special Meeting of Shareholders held on May 7, 2026. The filing covers standard matters submitted for a vote: election of 12 director nominees, reappointment of Deloitte LLP as external auditor, an advisory say-on-pay resolution, adoption of a new Management Share Option Plan, and amendments to an Escrowed Stock Plan. All proposals passed with overwhelming shareholder support. There are no special-situation events such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is purely informational regarding routine governance matters.
